title: NGS Library Prep for Targeted Sequencing of DNA Methylation Patterns
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Distribute premix and sample
steps.instruction: Using reagents from the Zymoresearch EZ DNA Methylation‑Gold Kit, dispense the premix and each patient sample into the designated DNA extraction plates according to the uploaded sample manifest.

steps.title: Pause for manual steps
steps.instruction: When the OT‑2 deck lights signal a pause, stop the robot run and perform any required manual interventions before continuing.

steps.title: Process beads and eluate
steps.instruction: Remove bead supernatants, combine beads from the DNA extraction plate with those from the duplicate plate, wash the beads, elute DNA, and transfer the eluate to a fresh PCR plate.

substeps.instruction: Remove bead supernatants from each well.
Combine beads from the DNA extraction plate with beads from the duplicate plate.
Wash the combined beads as specified by the kit protocol.
Elute DNA from the washed beads.
Transfer the eluate to a fresh PCR plate.
